name: Darius Laurent
source:
A strange boy who works for the Master. He looks no older than 13 but behaves like an adult and is an accomplished doctor. He was once an orphan until the Master took him in and gave a meaning to his life. He now takes care of the sick children in the centre and does his best to cure them. He desperately admires the Master and never stops seeking his approval.
[spoiler]He is actually 16 years old but looks 16 because of an incurable muscle disease. He probably only has two or three more years to live[/spoiler].

Brief information:
Symbol: Rag doll
Best quality: Compassion
Worst quality: Malleability
Main fear: Death
The most important thing in life: Serving the Master
Flower: Bindweed
Musical instrument: Music box

"I don't remember a single happy day in my life... until the moment I met the Master".

[From in-game character profile]
